marta: quick q — could sidecars locally request a fallback when they see p99 spikes or kv-miss surges?
kevin: local = faster. main risk is provenance. how do we trace requests?
ryan: attach a decision_id to every request. sidecar emits decision_request -> arbiter responds. tie logs/traces by id.
jess: +1. sidecar event example: `{decision_id: 'd-123', node: 'az1-node7', trigger: 'kv_miss_rate', val: 0.78, request: 'degrade'}`. store in trace-db.
marta: UX: operator inbox card should be compact: time / service / requester / reason / confidence. expand -> 20s signal window + link to replay. default collapse to avoid noise.
kevin: rollout config toggle: "allow sidecar fallback requests" with threshold, cooldown, notify-level. default OFF for SLA tenants.
ryan: handle flip-flop: sidecar requests are advisory; arbiter enforces hysteresis. console shows "requested by X — applied by Y".
jess: security: sidecars use mTLS + node signer token; audit log includes cert thumbprint. pilot in metrics-only mode first.
marta: action items: 1) runtime: add decision_id header (owner: jess, due EOW) 2) platform: arbiter API + audit schema (owner: ryan, due next Wed) 3) ux: inbox mock + timeline (owner: kevin, due Tue).
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INFRA-1599 for sidecar fallback pilot.
